observations.title: HighLevel hosted messaging can add SMS to eligible existing business numbers without moving voice service
observations.claim: HighLevel's support guide, modified October 30, 2026, describes Number Hosting (Hosted SMS/Hosted Messaging): an eligible business number can remain owned by its current carrier, with voice service continuing there, while supported SMS/MMS traffic is routed through LC Phone after verification and approval. The initial Labs self-service method is for eligible US local and toll-free numbers in GHL-managed Locations, supports SMS only, one number per request, and can be initiated only by Agency Owners/Admins where the feature is available. Support-assisted guidance covers eligible US/Canadian numbers and supported SMS/MMS. Hosting requires owner verification, a Letter of Authorization and carrier review; applicable A2P 10DLC or Toll-Free Verification, consent, sender identification and opt-out requirements still apply. Mobile/cellular numbers and numbers already using SMS with another provider are not eligible as currently configured; a Twilio voice number in another Twilio account is also excluded.
observations.why_now: First capture in the public ledger of a directly relevant route for a contractor to keep its familiar voice number and carrier while adding HighLevel messaging. The guide was modified October 30; this record does not claim a launch on the check date.
observations.observed_delta: New first-party capability record: hosted messaging can avoid porting voice service, but adds owner authorization, carrier review and separate messaging-registration requirements. No owner account entitlement or activation is assumed.
observations.value: No cash, credits or quantified savings. Potential reduction in number-porting friction only; the guide does not state hosting or account fees.
observations.eligibility: HighLevel Labs self-service, where available, for eligible US local/toll-free numbers in GHL-managed Locations; one number per request and Agency Owner/Admin initiation. Support-assisted guidance covers eligible US/Canada numbers. The owner's account access and plan entitlement are unknown.
observations.friction: Owner verification, signed LOA and carrier review are required. A2P 10DLC or Toll-Free Verification and consent/sender/opt-out rules still apply. Existing SMS with another provider is not eligible as configured; mobile numbers are excluded. Labs is SMS-only with no fixed completion time; Support-assisted guidance estimates 3–10 business days. Account and usage pricing are not established by this guide.
observations.anti_leverage: Do not claim this is free or enabled in the owner's account. Hosting does not bypass A2P/Toll-Free Verification, consent or opt-out rules. Do not disable an existing SMS provider or port a customer's number without carrier/HighLevel confirmation; do not assume mobile numbers qualify.

observations.title: Los Angeles remodeling-company listing requests a $2,000 GHL lead-management and missed-call workflow
observations.claim: An Upwork search-index snapshot for a listing posted November 19 describes ARZ Remodeling as a Los Angeles residential remodeling company seeking a complete lead-generation and CRM system. Advertised budget is $2,000 fixed, negotiable, with a 3–6 week timeline. Scope includes advertising lead capture, GoHighLevel pipelines and automated SMS/email/missed-call follow-up, lead qualification, appointment scheduling, FieldPulse integration and performance reporting. The snapshot shows 20–50 proposals and four interviews. The listing instructs applicants to use email only and prohibits unsolicited calls, texts and WhatsApp. Direct page retrieval returned HTTP 403; no job-specific award, funded milestone or payment is visible.
observations.why_now: New, relatively substantial home-services buyer-side request surfaced during the current recheck. It combines missed-call follow-up with booked-appointment and closed-project reporting, but remains a competitive, broad implementation project.
observations.observed_delta: New indexed listing with explicit paid-project intent and a $2,000 advertised budget; no hire or payment outcome is verified. The advertised company identity and job details remain unverified beyond the search index.
observations.value: $2,000 negotiable fixed-price budget advertised in the listing; not an awarded contract, funded milestone or settled payment.
observations.eligibility: Remote listing; preferred freelancer locations are US, Canada, UK or Europe. Requires demonstrable GHL, advertising, integration and reporting experience. The owner's eligibility or fit is not assessed.
observations.friction: 20–50 proposals and four interviews. Broad 3–6 week scope includes paid advertising, CRM, FieldPulse integration and reporting beyond missed-call recovery; advertising and third-party subscriptions are separate. Direct Upwork page returned HTTP 403. Listing requires email-only application and explicitly prohibits unsolicited calls/texts/WhatsApp; no contact or application was made.
observations.anti_leverage: Do not treat the advertised budget as recurring subscription demand or actual revenue. Do not contact the buyer; respect the listing's email-only and no-unsolicited-call policy. Separate the missed-call component from the much broader ads/CRM/integration scope.

observations.title: Recheck: $1,500 home-services voice-AI snapshot reaches its November 20 handoff date without a visible job-specific outcome
observations.claim: The current Upwork search-index snapshot still shows the $1,500 fixed-price home-services voice-AI snapshot listing with 20–50 proposals and 16 interviews; the client was last shown as viewing it two weeks ago. The final handoff milestone is dated November 20, 2026. At this check, no job-specific hire, completed milestone, funded award or settled payment is visible. The client profile's approximately $292 historical spend and two hires are account-wide figures, not attributable to this job. Direct page retrieval returned HTTP 403. The listed handoff date has arrived, but the available evidence does not establish whether the work was delivered or the job closed.
observations.why_now: Scheduled recheck of the November 20 handoff milestone. It is important to distinguish a milestone date arriving from verified completion, award or payment.
observations.observed_delta: Rechecked on the listed handoff date; proposal/interview snapshot remains visible but no job-specific outcome can be verified. Keep unresolved rather than marking CLOSED or completed.
observations.value: $1,500 advertised three-milestone project; no job-specific award, funded milestone, completed delivery or settled payment verified.
observations.eligibility: Worldwide listing seeking an expert GoHighLevel voice-AI builder with two live home-services examples, screen-share walkthrough, Top Rated/Expert-Vetted status and US Eastern-hours overlap.
observations.friction: 20–50 proposals and 16 interviews. Direct listing access is blocked; client-wide spend and hires are not attributable to this project. November 20 handoff date has no stated time zone, and no completion evidence is visible.
observations.anti_leverage: Do not mark CLOSED or completed merely because the milestone date arrived. Do not treat account-wide client spend or hires as payment for this job. A listing and interview count are not a funded milestone or settled payment.

observations.title: Reject $10 cleaning-company GHL listing as weak buyer evidence because the client profile conflicts with the stated business
observations.claim: An Upwork search-index snapshot for a listing posted November 19 says a Tampa commercial-cleaning company wants 50 office/property-manager leads with verified emails and direct phone numbers, plus a three-step SMS/email workflow and missed-call text-back, for $10 fixed. The snapshot shows 10–15 proposals and zero interviews. The associated public client profile identifies the account as based in Indonesia and categorized under Fashion & Beauty, which conflicts with the stated Tampa cleaning-company buyer identity. Direct page retrieval returned HTTP 403. No job-specific hire or payment is visible.
observations.why_now: Newly surfaced missed-call keyword listing was screened and rejected immediately because its public client profile conflicts with the stated end-customer identity and its $10 budget is implausible for the combined data-sourcing and workflow scope.
observations.observed_delta: First capture as negative intelligence: public listing description and client-profile category/location do not align. This is a reliability rejection, not a finding of fraud.
observations.value: $10 advertised fixed-price budget; no award or payment verified.
observations.eligibility: Worldwide Upwork listing; stated end customer is a Tampa commercial-cleaning company, but the public client profile does not corroborate that identity.
observations.friction: Profile location and industry conflict with the listing's stated buyer; 10–15 proposals and zero interviews; scope combines 50 verified business contacts with CRM/SMS workflow setup for $10. Direct page retrieval returned HTTP 403. Request for direct contact details raises data-quality and privacy considerations.
observations.anti_leverage: Do not treat this as verified Tampa cleaning-company demand or a valid $10 service-price benchmark. Do not replicate scraping or direct-contact-data collection. Profile mismatch is a reason to reject the signal, not proof of fraud.

observations.title: Recheck blocked: $500 home-services agency GHL paid-test listing cannot be independently resurfaced
observations.claim: The prior November 16 indexed snapshot described a home-services agency seeking a GoHighLevel specialist for a $500 paid test to build a reusable missed-call text-back snapshot, with conditional future rates of $500–$1,000 per build or $800–$1,200 per month. The scheduled November 19 recheck could not independently retrieve the listing: direct page retrieval returned HTTP 403 and a targeted search did not resurface the exact listing. No current hire, award, milestone or payment outcome can be verified. This is an access/recheck block, not evidence that the listing closed.
observations.why_now: The stored November 19 recheck date passed. Direct retrieval and targeted search did not provide a current job-specific status, so the evidence state must be marked blocked rather than carrying forward the original buyer claim as current.
observations.observed_delta: Recheck blocked by HTTP 403 and failure to independently resurface the exact listing. No closure, hire or payment is inferred.
observations.value: Previously advertised $500 paid test and conditional $500–$1,000 per-build / $800–$1,200 monthly rates; no award, recurring contract or payment verified.
observations.eligibility: Prior listing sought an experienced GHL specialist with home-services workflow/snapshot, A2P and Voice AI experience. Current listing availability and eligibility cannot be confirmed.
observations.friction: Direct page access blocked; exact listing not independently resurfaced in current targeted search. Prior snapshot showed 15–20 proposals and zero interviews. Proposed retainer was conditional, not a customer subscription or realized MRR.
observations.anti_leverage: Do not mark CLOSED based on a 403 or search nonappearance. Do not treat proposed retainer rates as revenue or verified willingness to pay. Recheck only if a reliable listing snapshot becomes accessible.
